Oscar-nominated actress Kirsten Dunst is keeping busy when it comes to her time in front of the camera, but recently recalled a terrifying incident behind the scenes that impacted her family as a whole.
During an
interview
with Town and Country magazine published Aug. 20, the 43-year-old said that her son James, 4, whom she shares with husband and fellow actor Jesse Plemons, suffered a “serious health scare” earlier this year.
